elaine: Quick postmortem follow-up: recurring failure modes are still appearing — dropped trace headers -> missing spans, ETL replay causing inflated aggregates, and checkpoint GC causing short ETL lag spikes. We need owners, short timelines, and a small backfill plan.
matt: I can own header propagation in edge + sdk shims. Plan: add header assertion, CI roundtrip test, deploy behind FF. ETA 48h, 24h canary. Rollback = flip feature flag. Blocker: CDN header passthrough confirmation.
sophie: I'll own ETL checkpoint durability and the dedupe pass. Plan: write immutable checkpoints to objectstore + sequence monotonic check; add a lightweight dedupe stage before rollups. ETA 3 business days. Backfill plan: targeted recompute for affected 3h window during low traffic. Rollback = restore rollup snapshot. Blocker: replica slot for swap.
ops-bot: Postmortem published: https://confluence.redwood.example/pm/204512  owner reminders created.
elaine: Please paste a 1-line verification and core backfill SQL snippet for infra review. Keep it short.
matt: verification (bash): `curl -H "X-Trace-ID: hdr-test" https://edge-test/redwood/ping | grep hdr-test`
sophie: backfill SQL (trimmed): `INSERT INTO rollup_staging (metric, window_start, value) SELECT metric, window_start, SUM(value) FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY request_id, metric, window_start ORDER BY event_ts DESC) rn FROM raw_events WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-04-01T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-01T05:00:00Z') t WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY metric, window_start;`
elaine: Success criteria: missing spans <0.05% after canary; rollup diff <0.5% post-backfill; ETL lag <90s steady-state. Flag if unrealistic.
matt: fine. I'll ping @cdn-team now.
sophie: I'll post runbook + dry-run checklist by EOD+2; need ops to reserve a 60m window.
infra: IAM note: backfill job needs rollup_writer + snapshot restore perms.
elaine: Deadlines: matt header PR + CI by EOD+2, sophie checkpoint + dedupe PR + runbook by EOD+3, ops schedule by EOD+1. Update thread if anything slips.
ops-bot: Reminder set: 2045123456-owners-checkin scheduled 2026-04-03T09:00:00Z.
elaine: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after dry-run/canary. Keep updates short in-thread.
